clue.text: Disorganized brawl — nobody's charged

definitions.meaning: a chaotic fight in which everyone joins in
a phrase for something open to everyone at no cost

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses come from the same idiom: a melee anyone may join, and entry with no price for anybody.

clue.text: In uplifting service, he offers religious teaching?

definitions.text: In uplifting service, he offers religious teaching?

indicators.note: the religious-teaching letters go inside the turned service, so 'In' signals insertion
in a down clue, uplifting means the service letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: the RAF is one of the armed services
RI is religious instruction, a school subject

explanation.surface: A clergyman at an inspiring service gives moral instruction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uplifting' turns the service upwards and 'In' sets the teaching inside it; read whole, the clue also describes a monk who preaches.
explanation.definitionFit: A mendicant brother of a religious order preaches and teaches the faith, which the whole clue describes.

clue.text: Undemanding jockey in film

parts.note: something undemanding is easy
a jockey is a rider of racehorses

explanation.surface: A jockey with an easy ride appears in a movie.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1969 road movie starring Peter Fonda and Dennis Hopper is a famous film title.

clue.text: Decent prospect of beating the odds?

definitions.text: Decent prospect of beating the odds?

parts.words: Decent prospect of beating the odds?
parts.note: read straight it is a reasonable hope of success; read cryptically 'beating' is combat, so a punch-up's opportunity

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a realistic possibility of success if one makes the effort, a reasonable prospect.

clue.text: Rebukes for ordinary seamen

definitions.meaning: a rating is a sharp scolding, an old sense of the verb rate
naval sailors below officer rank are called by this term

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both scoldings (from the verb rate, to berate) and non-commissioned sailors in the navy.

clue.text: Greek character describing a Brazilian dance

indicators.note: to describe a shape is to draw round it, so the Greek letter goes around the next word

parts.note: lambda is the eleventh letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A man from Greece is writing about a dance from Brazil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'describing' puts LAMBDA round A, giving LAMB-A-DA.
explanation.definitionFit: The fast, sensual couples dance originated in Brazil and was a worldwide craze in 1989.

clue.text: Gunpowder, for one, left in container

indicators.note: the abbreviation for left sits inside the container word

parts.note: a pot is a container

explanation.surface: Gunpowder has been left lying in a canister.
explanation.walkthrough: The Gunpowder Plot was the 1605 conspiracy to blow up the English Parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gunpowder Plot is an example of a conspiracy, hence the 'for one' signalling an example.

clue.text: Girl exercising daily

indicators.note: exercising suggests letters being worked and moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: A young woman works out every day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exercising' rearranges DAILY.
explanation.definitionFit: Lydia is a common female forename, so a girl's name.

clue.text: Textile dye produced by communist country originally

parts.note: Turkey is a country
a Red is a communist

explanation.surface: A dye for cloth was first made in a communist state.
explanation.walkthrough: The communist word comes first in the clue but last in the answer; 'originally' hints that the dye came from that country.
explanation.definitionFit: Turkey red is a bright red dye made from madder root, used for cotton fabrics.

clue.text: A cabby can manage without his tips

definitions.text: A cabby can manage without his tips

parts.words: A cabby can manage without his tips
parts.note: a taxi driver would rather not receive driving advice from the passenger behind him, punning on tips as advice rather than gratuities

explanation.definitionFit: This phrase names a passenger who constantly gives unwanted advice to the person at the wheel.

clue.text: Penetration, in a sense

parts.note: taken as written
sight is one of the five senses

explanation.surface: Penetration is understood in a particular sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Penetration can mean perceptive understanding, keen discernment into a matter.

clue.text: Wind, more vicious round centre of Cadiz

indicators.note: the comparative adjective wraps around the Spanish city's middle letter

parts.note: meaner means more vicious or nastier

indicators.note: the middle letter of the five-letter city name

explanation.surface: A nastier wind blows around the middle of Cadiz.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' puts D, from 'centre of' Cadiz, inside MEANER.
explanation.definitionFit: To wind is to follow a twisting course, as a river does, so a verb synonym.

clue.text: I turn aria, with new arrangement, into Land of Hope …

indicators.note: the letters are arranged afresh, as music might be rearranged

explanation.surface: A singer rearranges an aria into 'Land of Hope and Glory'.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with new arrangement' shuffles I TURN ARIA. The definition nods to Anthony Hope, author of The Prisoner of Zenda, set in this fictional kingdom.
explanation.definitionFit: This imaginary Central European kingdom was created by novelist Anthony Hope, so it is his land.

clue.text: Card, king, Welshman rejected

parts.note: K is the abbreviation for king in chess and cards

indicators.note: something rejected is turned back, so the Welsh name reads backwards

parts.note: Evan is a typical Welsh man's name

explanation.surface: A Welshman is turned down at a card table by the king.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns EVAN into NAVE.
explanation.definitionFit: The knave is the jack in a pack of playing cards.

clue.text: Ancient city is recalled by university teacher

indicators.note: called back, so the little word is read backwards

parts.note: a don is a university lecturer, especially at Oxford or Cambridge

explanation.surface: An old city is remembered by an academic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' turns IS into SI.
explanation.definitionFit: Sidon was an ancient Phoenician port city in what is now Lebanon.

clue.text: Distract team on course

parts.note: a side is a team
a track is a racecourse or path

explanation.surface: A team's attention is diverted at the racecourse.
explanation.definitionFit: To divert someone from their main purpose is to draw their attention away, a verb synonym.

clue.text: One trying to get his own back on son caught by sweeper

indicators.note: one piece placed after another, written on it

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

parts.words: One trying to get his own back
parts.note: an avenger seeks revenge

explanation.surface: A man seeking revenge on his son is caught by a street cleaner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' sets AVENGER after S and C.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal or person that removes refuse or carrion clears up what is left, like a street sweeper.

clue.text: Ignore lad that's set off firework

indicators.note: set off suggests a firework being lit and scattering, so these letters explode into a new order

explanation.surface: A boy ignores a firework that has been lit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set off' rearranges IGNORE LAD.
explanation.definitionFit: A girandole is a rotating firework throwing out jets, like a Catherine wheel.

clue.text: Sordid material and Ecstasy secured by bloke at an extremely low price

parts.note: dirt is filthy matter, or sordid gossip

indicators.note: held inside the man word, so it is surrounded

parts.note: chap is British slang for a man
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A man buys dirty magazines and drugs at a bargain price.
explanation.walkthrough: 'secured by' puts E inside CHAP.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means extremely inexpensive, costing next to nothing.

clue.text: Most violent end

definitions.meaning: the utmost or most severe in degree
the farthest point or limit of something

explanation.definitionFit: The word works as a superlative-like adjective for most severe and as a noun for the outermost limit.

clue.text: Missile's power sailor misinterpreted

parts.note: P is the physics abbreviation for power

indicators.note: the sailor letters are read wrongly, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sailor misreads the power of a missile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misinterpreted' rearranges SAILOR into OLARIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Polaris was an American submarine-launched ballistic missile, also used by the Royal Navy.

clue.text: Played out, even round river

indicators.note: the level-score word is placed around the river abbreviation

parts.note: a game that is even is tied
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A match ended level after being played around a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' puts R inside TIED.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone played out is exhausted, used up, which is a synonym of weary.

clue.text: Jewellery one found among Scarlett's property?

indicators.note: the numeral letter is placed inside the estate name

parts.note: Tara is the plantation of Scarlett O'Hara in Gone with the Wind
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A piece of jewellery is discovered in Scarlett O'Hara's estate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'found among' puts I inside TARA, the plantation home in Margaret Mitchell's novel.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiara is a jewelled ornamental headband, an example of jewellery.

clue.text: Boy wantonly arrested

indicators.note: arrested means held in, so the name is caught inside the word

explanation.surface: A boy behaving recklessly is taken into custody.
explanation.definitionFit: Anton is a male forename, so a boy's name.

clue.text: Patience has dream about beheaded spy

indicators.note: the dreamy state goes around the shortened spy word

parts.note: a trance is a dreamlike state

indicators.note: with its first letter cut off

parts.note: a mole is a spy planted inside an organisation

explanation.surface: Patience dreams of a spy who has been beheaded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Patience' looks like the card game but is the definition; 'beheaded' drops the spy's first letter and 'about' wraps the dream round what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: Tolerance is forbearance, the ability to endure without complaint, close to patience.

clue.text: Order English concise dictionary

parts.note: dict is the short form of dictionary, as a concise version is shortened; that the letters also run across 'concise dictionary' is a coincidence, with no hiding indicator

explanation.surface: An order appears in the Concise English Dictionary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'concise' clips the word dictionary to DICT.
explanation.definitionFit: An edict is an official decree or proclamation, a formal command.

clue.text: Item in lorry, extremely large

parts.note: an artic is an articulated lorry, British for a semi-trailer truck

indicators.note: taking the extremes, the first and last letters of the word

explanation.surface: An item in a lorry is very big.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' takes L and E from large.
explanation.definitionFit: An article is an individual object or piece, an item of goods.

clue.text: Right to put drop of vinegar in mayonnaise for this dish

indicators.note: the vinegar's letter is put inside the garlic sauce word

parts.note: aioli is a garlic mayonnaise

indicators.note: a drop of something is a little of it, the first letter

explanation.surface: A cook adds a dash of vinegar to mayonnaise for a dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drop of' gives V from vinegar; 'in' puts it inside AIOLI.
explanation.definitionFit: Ravioli is an Italian dish of small pasta parcels with a filling.

clue.text: Considerate type

definitions.meaning: a sort or category of thing

explanation.definitionFit: The word is an adjective for benevolent and gentle and a noun for a sort or class.

clue.text: Legendary creature aspen trees camouflaged

indicators.note: camouflaged things are disguised, so the letters are rearranged into a new form

explanation.surface: A mythical monster hides among aspen trees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'camouflaged' rearranges ASPEN TREES.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea serpent is a mythical giant snake-like monster of the ocean, a creature of legend.
